references.text: These verses describe the same calculation method for redemption money, where one counts the years from the sale to the Jubilee year and calculates the price based on the number of remaining years.
The introduction of the Jubilee year as the central point for release, which forms the basis for calculating the redemption money in verse 52.
A similar principle for calculating redemption money based on the years that have passed, here applied to property instead of servants.
The context for redeeming an Israelite who has sold himself to a foreigner, of which verse 52 is a continuation.
Related laws concerning the release of Hebrew servants and the principle of fair treatment upon liberation.
